step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified user entry points from visual icons and audio context: Web Client (UserConsumerWeb), Mobile Device (UserConsumerMobile), and Alexa Device (UserConsumerAlexaGoogleHome).
2. Identified central conversational interface powered by Amazon Lex (Lex).
3. Identified backend data stores: Amazon DynamoDB (DynamoDB) storing building hours, and External Partner Databases (ThirdParty) storing food vendor schedules.
4. Identified notification and ML services: Amazon SNS (SNS) for email alerts on user feedback, Amazon Comprehend (Comprehend) for key phrase extraction, and Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) for real-time question scoring.
5. Structured logical flows: Flow 0 for student Q&A chat interactions and database lookups; Flow 1 for negative user feedback notification via SNS; Flow 2 for intent testing and keyword optimization via Elasticsearch and Comprehend.

graph.name: Saint Louis University Q&A Chatbot Architecture
graph.notes: Saint Louis University utilizes an open-source Q&A chatbot powered by Amazon Lex to serve over 12,000 students and 2,000 faculty across web, mobile text, and Alexa channels.

nodes.name: Web Client
nodes.notes: Web interface on the university website used by students to ask questions.

nodes.name: Mobile Device
nodes.notes: Mobile text messaging interface for students on the move.

nodes.name: Alexa Device
nodes.notes: Alexa smart devices installed in student residence halls.

nodes.name: Lex
nodes.notes: Core Amazon Lex service powering the Q&A chatbot solution.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores building and library operational hours, including default schedules, holiday schedules, and break hours.

nodes.name: External Partner Databases
nodes.notes: External food vendor databases queried to retrieve up-to-date dining menus and schedules.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Sends notification emails to content owners when negative user feedback (thumbs down) is submitted.

nodes.name: Comprehend
nodes.notes: Analyzes text to extract key subjects, nouns, and verbs while ignoring common linking words to improve accuracy.

nodes.name: Elasticsearch
nodes.notes: Provides real-time scoring on all questions entered to test response accuracy and mapping.

edges.notes: Web client submits question to Lex chatbot.
Mobile text client submits question to Lex chatbot.
Alexa device sends voice query to Lex chatbot.
Lex queries DynamoDB to retrieve specific building and library hours.
Lex fetches real-time dining menu data from external partner databases.
Lex triggers SNS email notification to content owners when negative user feedback is logged.
Lex integrates with Elasticsearch for real-time scoring and testing of question-answer pairs.
Lex uses Comprehend to hone in on key nouns and verbs to optimize intent recognition.
